seo.meta_title: What Is Soft Top at Dutch Bros? Taste, Ingredients & Tips
seo.meta_description: Soft Top is Dutch Bros' sweet, fluffy cream topping for iced and blended drinks. What it tastes like, what's in it, allergens and how to order it.
seo.h1: What Is Soft Top at Dutch Bros?

question: What Is Soft Top at Dutch Bros?
quick_answer: Soft Top is Dutch Bros' own sweet cream topping. It is a thick, fluffy foam, somewhere between whipped cream and cold foam, that sits on top of iced and blended drinks so the first sip is sweet and creamy. It comes standard on some drinks, like many cold brews, and you can add it to almost any iced or blended drink for a small extra charge. It contains milk and soy.
key_facts: A sweet, fluffy cream topping made by Dutch Bros
Thicker than cold foam, lighter than whipped cream
Standard on many cold brews; can be added to iced and blended drinks
Can be flavored with any syrup, such as caramel or raspberry

body.heading: What Soft Top is
body.text: Soft Top is a house topping that Dutch Bros adds to many of its drinks. It is a lightly whipped sweet cream that stays on top of the drink instead of sinking in, so you get a sweet, creamy layer first and the coffee or Rebel energy drink underneath. Dutch Bros describes it as what makes the perfect first sip.

body.heading: What it tastes like
body.text: Most people describe Soft Top as sweet, rich and a little like vanilla. It is thicker than the cold foam at many coffee chains but lighter than canned whipped cream. Fans often compare it to Cool Whip or marshmallow fluff, and one Dutch Bros employee online called it a half-whipped cream.

body.heading: What's in it
body.text: Dutch Bros has not published a full recipe. Based on what fans and former staff have shared, it is a pourable whipped cream base blended with sweetener and vanilla, and some reports mention buttermilk. Dutch Bros does list milk and soy as allergens in Soft Top, so it is not dairy-free, even if the rest of your drink is made with oat, almond or coconut milk.

body.heading: Which drinks have it and how to order
body.text: Soft Top comes on many Dutch Bros cold brews and some seasonal and blended drinks, and you can add it to almost any iced or blended drink, including Rebels, iced coffees and sodas, for a small upcharge that varies by location. You can also ask for a flavored Soft Top. Because syrup is mixed into the base, choices like caramel, white chocolate or raspberry are popular.

body.heading: Soft Top vs. cold foam vs. whipped cream
body.text: Cold foam is frothed milk and is lighter and thinner. Whipped cream is fully whipped and stiff, and it melts into a hot drink quickly. Soft Top sits in between: thick enough to float on an iced drink for a while, but soft enough to sip through. If you like sweet, creamy drinks, it is one of the easiest ways to upgrade a Dutch Bros order.

faqs.q: What does Soft Top taste like?
faqs.a: Sweet and creamy with a light vanilla flavor. Many people compare it to Cool Whip or a thick sweet cream cold foam.

faqs.q: Is Dutch Bros Soft Top dairy-free?
faqs.a: No. Dutch Bros lists milk and soy in Soft Top, so it is not suitable for a dairy-free order.
It comes standard on some drinks. Adding it to others costs a small extra charge, which varies by location.

faqs.q: Can you get flavored Soft Top?
faqs.a: Yes. You can ask for a syrup to be blended into the Soft Top, such as caramel or raspberry.

faqs.q: Is Soft Top the same as cold foam?
faqs.a: No. Soft Top is thicker and sweeter than most cold foam and sits on top of the drink longer.
